profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker CDNS. Its website describes it as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The company also describes itself as a great place to work, citing Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work and an investment in sustainability.

The harvested site text does not name specific AI products, and no products are tracked for the company. Its stated position rests on electronic design automation and intelligent system design rather than on named AI offerings.

The company's SEC filing record lists CIK 0000813672. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
